'''Bludgeoner''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] dropped by [[Thorgall Bludgeonhammer]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Grenth's Footprint]].

==Stats==
:[[Blunt damage]] 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% ([[while Enchanted]])
:[[Armor penetration]] 20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Foehammer]].

*[[Foehammer]] from collector [[Heather Meyre]]
